newsitem.title: SPAIN: Endesa '96 net profit 165.09 bln ptas.
newsitem.headline: Endesa '96 net profit 165.09 bln ptas.

text.p: Full 1996 results for Spain's Endesa group in billions of pesetas, unless stated:
NOTE: Endesa said the consolidation of Fecsa and Sevillana in the group along with the updating of asset values meant a 77.5 percent increase in group activity to 3.79 trillion pesetas.
Sales to final clients rose 3.7 percent, putting Endesa's total market share at 43.0 percent.
The average rate of interest on debt fell to 7.5 percent in 1996 versus 8.3 percent in 1995, while average debt in comparable terms fell 16 percent.
Endesa said including the effect of buying 75 percent of Sevillana and Fecsa, operating income rose 46.4 percent in 1996, while operating costs rose 48.2 percent.
Excluding the purchases operating income fell 0.2 percent, while operating costs fell 2.6 percent.
Endesa said personnel costs rose 4.2 percent.
Due to the purchase of Fecsa and Sevillana, debt increased by 56 percent although excluding this effect, debt fell 16.6 percent.
Investment in fixed assets rose to 196.23 billion pesetas from 131.98 billion.
